# Meenakshi Fly Bricks
https://meenatchi-dev.github.io/fly-ash-bricks/

# Company
Meenakshi Fly Bricks is a manufacturer and supplier of premium fly ash bricks and concrete blocks located in Keela Ambur, Tenkasi, Tamil Nadu, India. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, durable, eco-friendly, and cost-effective construction materials for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
